description: Defines the processor_handler_adaptor class which adapts lower physical layer handlers to internal request handlers, including nested adaptor classes for downlink and uplink handling.

classes.name: processor_handler_adaptor
classes.description: Adapts lower physical layer handlers to internal processor request handlers, providing access to downlink and uplink handlers.

classes.name: processor_handler_adaptor::downlink_handler_adaptor
classes.description: Adaptor class for lower_phy_downlink_handler, connects to a pdxch_processor_request_handler.

classes.name: processor_handler_adaptor::uplink_request_handler_adaptor
classes.description: Adaptor class for lower_phy_uplink_request_handler, connects to prach and puxch processor handlers.

methods.name: get_downlink_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the downlink handler.

methods.name: get_uplink_request_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to the uplink request handler.

methods.name: handle_resource_grid
methods.description: Handles resource grid in downlink adaptor (implementation not shown).

methods.name: request_prach_window
methods.description: Handles PRACH window request in uplink adaptor (implementation not shown).

methods.name: request_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles uplink slot request in uplink adaptor (implementation not shown).
